description: This file defines the StoreFilter class, a Spring MVC HandlerInterceptorAdapter that manages store-related context setup for incoming HTTP requests in an e-commerce web application. It handles session and request attributes for store data, customer info, language, breadcrumbs, and caches various content and configuration objects.

classes.name: StoreFilter
classes.description: A Spring MVC interceptor for setting up store-specific context, session attributes, content, configuration, and navigation breadcrumbs before handling requests.

methods.name: preHandle
methods.description: Intercepts the incoming HTTP request to set up session attributes for store, customer, language, breadcrumbs, and various cached content and configuration objects.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves merchant configurations for the store, either from cache or database, and sets them in request attributes.

methods.name: getContentPageNames
methods.description: Loads and caches content page name descriptions for the store and language, sets them as request attributes.

methods.name: getContentObjects
methods.description: Loads and caches content objects like boxes and sections for the current store and language.

methods.name: getTopCategories
methods.description: Loads and caches top category data for the store and language.

methods.name: getContentPagesNames
methods.description: Returns a map of content page descriptions keyed by store ID and language code.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns a map of content objects (boxes and sections) by store ID and language code.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns a map of categories with descriptions, for the store and language.

methods.name: getConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves merchant configuration settings from the database.

methods.name: setBreadcrumb
methods.description: Builds breadcrumb navigation trail based on the current session state, product, category, or content context.

methods.name: getDefaultBreadcrumbItem
methods.description: Creates a default breadcrumb item representing the home page.

methods.name: setMerchantStoreInSession
methods.description: Sets the MerchantStore object in the HTTP session based on store code from request parameter.
